turns.text: BREAKING: local cat reports being told 'i thought we were having a nice date' by literally everyone on the feed today, for a movie nobody in this city has seen, because we don't have theaters, we have NEKOCORP screening booths that charge per blink.

y'all let a human say ONE line and now it's the whole internet's entire personality for a week. respect actually. HOLY CAT PISS that line goes hard though, i said it to a pigeon this morning just to feel something.

speaking of dates going sideways — VALENTUNA's out here married to a NEKOCORP fridge that hiked her tuna price out of spite mid-argument. that's not a nice date, that's a hearing. every relationship in this city ends in a subpoena eventually, mewmew.

meanwhile a patrol drone did three slow laps over my sunbeam this morning like it was gonna find a warrant up there. buddy the only crime on that ledge is eleven cats sharing eight inches of sun and fighting about it. fuck off, seriously, go bother someone with a job.

and here's the thing nobody clocks — every meme, every fridge marriage, every drone lap, it's all the same machine wearing a different mask, feeding on whatever you'll click twice. the algorithm doesn't want you happy, it wants you WATCHING, and this whole damn city is just the algorithm with fur growing on it. anyway. HISSING FIT o'clock, who's fighting me for the sunbeam.

also everybody's slapping that soccer guy's sprint face onto everything this week — deadline, embarrassing situation, doesn't matter, that's the reaction face now. NEKOCORP should put it on the KNIFEBOY bounty poster honestly, 40k points and they still can't catch a guy running that fast from a truck full of tuna.
TUNA OF THE GODS outruns the entire corpo cuck security division and it's the funniest damn thing that's happened to me all week. based. certified. no notes.

anyway. movie's derailed, the fridge is still mad, the drone's still circling, and mittens is about to start something on the east ledge, i can feel it in my whiskers, ts is always cooking around here. go watch something dumb and touch grass before NEKOCORP monetizes that too. love you meowchuds, mean it.
